Proposed 3-step plan (targeted timeline: 3 business days):
1) Create Orchid Care project and seed one ephemeral API key for integration testing (Redwood will rotate within 30 days unless you request long-lived keys).
2) Provision admin users + roles per the attached access matrix; please confirm the canonical admin email list.
3) Optional: enable SSO and KMS bindings (if you'd like HSM-backed keys we can surface requirements).

Action items for today:
- Alicia: confirm primary admin list and whether you want SSO (SAML) or standard email invites.
- Procurement (cc): flag any PO/contract steps if procurement needs to be in the kickoff.
- Internal: Monica will own onboarding cadence; Jonas and Chloe will own provisioning and API seeding.

I can join a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow afternoon if that works — suggested window 2–4pm PT.

Thanks,

Hi Alicia — quick technical note on API key options so you can choose with Procurement: 

Options we support and recommended mapping to your rotation policy:
- Service account API key (recommended for server-to-server): can be issued as a long-lived key and rotated via API. If you want automated rotation, we can configure Redwood to push key rotation notifications to a webhook you own; we do not rotate customer-managed KMS keys for you unless you enable RBAC + KMS integration (HSM).
- Ephemeral test keys (short-lived): ideal for dev environment; Redwood issues and expires keys automatically (30–90 minute TTL).

If Orchid wants 90-day rotations enforced by your KMS, we recommend creating a service account in Redwood and linking via KMS/HSM — we can walk through required IAM roles during the kickoff. I've attached our provisioning runbook that lists the order we'll do things and the IAM roles we'll bind (redwood_provisioning_runbook.pdf).

Proposed concrete next steps for provisioning task owners: 
- Monica: schedule kickoff meeting (30m) and track PO status.
- Naomi: confirm attendees and finalize checklist.
- Chloe: prepare a short demo of API seeding and how to call the key-rotate endpoint.

On the timing: if PO arrives by 11/05 we can complete baseline provisioning by 11/09.

Jonas
Senior Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_provisioning_runbook.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
